recentItems.title: We Made The Game Pick Between 50 Cent vs Eminem & De La Soul vs A Tribe Called Quest | Sound Check
recentItems.description:
The Game stopped by for an episode of Sound Check where host Jeremy Hecht forced him to make some difficult music decisions. Game chose between some of his favorite artists of all time, diss tracks against him and even his own songs. At the end of the show, Jeremy had to guess what his all time favorite song was.

recentItems.title: Ari Lennox "Horoscope" Live Performance | VISIONARIES by UPROXX Studios
recentItems.description:
Ari Lennox steps onto the VISIONARIES XR stage for a stunning live performance of her song "Horoscope" from her new album "Vacancy." The screen behind her includes a unique technology that's reactive to Ari's movements and vocals so the entire visual is being created in real time as she sings. Welcome to VISIONARIES.
